title: Measuring Scalar Constructs in Social Science with LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Measured during pairwise comparison tasks by swapping the order of text items and choice labels in the prompt to detect if the model systematically favors the first option presented.

Evaluated during pointwise scoring tasks by analyzing the distribution of the model's responses to see if they disproportionately concentrate on specific numeric tokens (e.g., scale extremes like 1 and 9) rather than utilizing the full continuous scale.
